question: Ram Sahay Pandey, a Padma Shri 2022 awardee, is associated with which of the following dance forms of the Bedia community of Madhya Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rai**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Ram Sahay Pandey was awarded the Padma Shri for his contribution to Bundeli Folk Dance in 2022.
 
• Ram Sahay Panday is a **Rai dancer** from Madhya Pradesh's sagar district.
 
• The Rai dance was traditionally associated with the Bedia community.
 
• Though he was not the member of the community he devoted his whole life practicing and performing the Rai dance and to secure acceptance and respectability for the dance form.
 
• His efforts helped him obtain national and international recognition of Rai dance form.
 
• The dance form Raai (or Rai) is basically a folk dance of the Bundelkhand region. 
 
• In the year 2022, Govt of India honoured Ram Sahay Panday by conferring the Padma Shri award for his contributions to art.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Badhai:

 
 
• Badhai is** one of the popular folk dances of Madhya Pradesh,** especially in the Bundelkhand region.
 
• It is a **ceremonial dance**, performed on childbirth, marriages or any other get together to celebrate happiness and joy.
 
• The **musical instruments used are Dhapla, Timki, Lota, Rantula & Algoja.**
 
 
 
• **Karma****​**
 
 
• Khemta and Bhinusari __are the two forms of Karma dance.
 
• Karma dance is a traditional dance of central and Eastern India annually performed during the karma festival. 
 
• It is performed in Jharkhand and its adjacent states of Chhattisgarh, West Orissa and Madhya Pradesh.
 
• It is held during the autumn season.
 
 
 
• **Ravala**
 
 
• **Ravala Dance** is a traditional folk dance from the state of **Rajasthan**, India.
 
• It is performed by the **Ravala community**, which is part of the larger **Rajput** or **Gujjar** groups.
 
• This dance is a vibrant and energetic form of expression that showcases the rich cultural heritage of Rajasthan
 
• The dance is usually performed during **festivals** and **cultural celebrations**.
